content:
As Amazon's fall Prime Day event is currently underway, this year is one of the best times to upgrade your AirPods. Although we are still waiting for holiday pricing on Apple's latest AirPods 5, since the AirPods Pro 3 has dropped to such a low price, it may actually be a more worthwhile choice for most people; for those who want to experience Apple's over-ear headphones, the AirPods Max 2, launched in 2026, is currently discounted by US$120 across all five colourways.

  • AirPods Pro 3 US$179 (original price US$249)
  • AirPods Max 2 US$429 (original price US$549)

This time, Apple has added active noise cancellation to the new entry-level AirPods 5 at the same US$129 price point, a feature the previous generation lacked, which I personally find quite a pleasant surprise. However, to get the wireless charging case, you'll need to upgrade to the US$149 version; in other words, for just US$30 more now, you can get the more advanced, higher-end AirPods Pro — for me, this is a no-brainer.

Originally priced at US$249, now US$70 off, just US$10 shy of the all-time low we've recorded at Amazon — a price we've only logged once since the product launched.

The new AirPods 5 will almost certainly fall back to the US$100 mark or below in the future, but based on past experience and the trajectory of the previous generation, it may not drop below the US$99 threshold until later in 2027. Even if it does get cheaper by then, the AirPods Pro 3 still offers 3 times better noise cancellation, longer battery life, a built-in heart rate sensor, a suite of hearing aid features, and in my view, a more comfortable fit.

This is a pretty compelling reason to choose the Pro 3 over the new 5 series; but if it's Apple's top-tier over-ear headphones you have your heart set on, then the fall Prime Day discount on the 2026 Max 2 is where the real action is.

The current price is only US$30 above the all-time low we've recorded at Amazon, all five colourways are available, and it's US$120 off the original price.

Worth noting that since its launch earlier this year, this is only the second time we've seen it priced this low, with just one instance of a lower price previously.

Top brands like Sony and Bose also have plenty of headphone deals worth checking out (listed below), but if you ask me, nothing beats the personal listening experience designed in-house by Cupertino. If you're still not convinced, there are some pretty solid options below, as well as a basket of selected deals covering the entire Apple ecosystem.
